_comment: Drills as vertices of the graph. The key is the drill's id (d1, d2, ...): assigned once, never reused, the way LeetCode numbers are; it is what "after" lists, make prepare and make next use. "title" is what make next, make rep and the commit show; nothing reads it from a file. "file" is the bank file, relative to drills/: the one place an id meets its file. A rep's evidence entry carries the id as "drill" (written by make solved from .drill.json, 2026-10-24); the reps are found by that, never by the title or a filename. "after": [ids] - what this drill builds on; an id is a drill id, a problem number, or a node id, and the drill is not served until each is warm (kg_lib.warm). Filename order means nothing. Seeded 2026-08-31 from the bank's former filename order. "trains" is the list of node ids the drill evidences; it lives here, keyed by the stable id, so a node rename never touches a bank file or a solved copy.
